text: dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki 是让 DSH agent 使用本地 Obsidian 知识库的插件。它注册读取、列目录、写入、追加和搜索工具，并在启动时将 vault 中的 Markdown 与文本文件建成内存 SQLite 索引。wiki_search 支持关键词子串，以及路径、分类、项目和标签筛选，结果按匹配次数排序并附文本片段；插件写入或追加的笔记会立即重新索引。适合希望 agent 查阅和维护 Obsidian 笔记的人。需要配置 vaultPath 或 OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH，并使用 Node.js 22.5 及以上版本。

dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki links DSH agents to Obsidian notes. It reads, lists, writes, appends, and searches files. Startup indexes Markdown and text in SQLite; search offers substring queries and filters by path, category, project, and tag. Set vaultPath or OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH. Needs Node.js 22.5+.
想让 DSH agent 搜索我的 Obsidian 笔记，并按项目或标签筛选结果。
能不能让 agent 直接读取和浏览本地知识库里的 Markdown 文件？
我希望 agent 新增笔记后，搜索索引也能马上更新。
dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki 的功能「筛选搜索笔记」：启动时为 vault 文本建立 SQLite 索引。调用 wiki_search 输入关键词，可按路径、分类、项目或标签筛选，查看排序结果与片段。
dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki 的功能「维护笔记」：agent 可调用 wiki_read、wiki_list、wiki_write、wiki_append 读取、浏览、覆盖或追加 vault 文件；写入后立即更新索引。

dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki README · dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki：SQLite-indexed Obsidian memory for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — gives the agent a **searchable** view of a local Obsidian vault, with no frontend (browse and edit notes in Obsidian itself).

Built on Node 22's built-in `node:sqlite` — zero runtime dependencies.

dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki README · Why：Plain file-system memory plugins scan every file linearly and can't filter by directory. This plugin indexes the vault into an in-memory SQLite table at startup and keeps it fresh on every write, so the agent can:

- full-text search any substring (including 2-character Chinese words),
- filter by `path` / `category` / `project` / `tag`,
- get results ranked by match count.

dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki

dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki README · or from source:：dsh plugin add CagierAsh123/dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki
```

dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki README · Configure：Point the plugin at your vault in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki
  name: dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki
  config:
    vaultPath: B:/path/to/your/vault

Or set the `OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH` env var. Restart dsh.

dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki README · Tools：| Tool | Parameters | Purpose |
|------|-----------|---------|
| `wiki_read` | `file_path` | Read a note |
| `wiki_list` | `path?` | List a directory |
| `wiki_write` | `file_path`, `content` | Write / overwrite, then re-index |
| `wiki_append` | `file_path`, `content` | Append, then re-index |
| `wiki_search` | `query`, `path?`, `category?`, `project?`, `tag?`, `limit?` | Indexed full-text + structured search |
dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki README · Tools：`wiki_search` returns `path`, `title`, `category`, `project`, `matches`, and a `snippet` for each hit, ordered by match count.

dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki README · Vault layout：`category` and `project` are inferred from each note's path:

- `代码Wiki/<topic>/<note>.md` → category `代码Wiki` (shared technical notes)
- `项目Wiki/<project>/<note>.md` → category `项目Wiki`, project `<project>`

`tag` filtering matches the frontmatter `tags:` value.

dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki README · How indexing works：- **At startup** the plugin scans the vault (skipping `.obsidian`/`.git`/`node_modules`/`.trash`) and builds the in-memory index.
- **On `wiki_write` / `wiki_append`** the touched note is re-indexed immediately.
- Manual edits made in Obsidian are picked up on the next dsh restart.

dsh-obsidian-agent-wiki README · How indexing works：Full-text matching uses `LIKE '%query%'` rather than FTS5 trigram because trigram returns zero hits for queries shorter than 3 characters — which would drop the 2-character Chinese words that dominate a Chinese vault. At tens-to-hundreds of notes, a `LIKE` scan is sub-millisecond.
